notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
When the Squirrels enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 at least three additional times. Afterwards, resolve any remaining Blasting Station triggers.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
